listingTitle: Avoid Python string concatenation in loops
title: Avoid Python string concatenation in loops
why: Strings are immutable, so repeatedly extending a growing string can copy the accumulated prefix on each iteration.
suggestion: Append fragments to a list and call ''.join once after the loop, or stream directly to the destination.
limitations: Only += on variables explicitly annotated as str or initialized from a string literal before the active loop is reported.
Reassignment, variable shadowing, bounded loops, and alternative string-like types are not inferred.
